comments.author: reviewer
comments.body:
Round-1 artifact review (cold read of c4ebaa4e vs docs/compat/briefs/21-world-live-harness.md + revision_boundary_live pattern).

Scope hygiene OK: commit only adds world_boundary_live.rs, 03a-world-live-harness.md, support-checks.log; no production/source/WIP edits. Clean-tree support checks re-verified PASS:
- cargo test -p host-play --test world_boundary_live --features memory-profile --no-run
- cargo clippy -p host-play --test world_boundary_live --features memory-profile --no-deps -- -D warnings
(Dirty banking WIP in the shared worktree breaks host-play match arms; not part of this commit.)

Blocking contract gaps in crates/host-play/tests/world_boundary_live.rs:

1. Mainland seed + observed logout/relogin before proof baseline is missing for every cell. Brief requires the revision_boundary_live-style disposable account + local mainland seed + relog before baseline. Harness only logs in once; no seed_at/mainland_hop/logout/relogin; ScenarioRunner.require_mainland_base stays default false so seed can release off tutorial.

2. nav_full must set scenario engine_speed_ms to None and record that fixture setting. Shared nav_full still has with_tick_ms(300); harness builds ScenarioRunner without clearing it, so the runner will cheat `speed 300` and change engine tick rate — forbidden for this campaign cell.

3. nav_door must be a bounded single-account cell reusing Traveller/router + Catherby outside/inside fixtures, not the fleet slam scenario. Do not use the two-bot closer companion. Prepare at outside stand, ensure/observe door closed before baseline, require route-caused open + inside arrival, emit before/after door identity and Traveller/runner evidence. Preserve existing send/settlement timeouts (do not zero scene_settle). Process outer bound 180s remains.

4. guardian_lamp is under-specified vs brief: after mainland relog, give lamp; capture inventory + strength XP before enabling Guardian; observe hold, real lamp skill interface, consumption, increased selected-skill XP, lifted hold, then a post-resolution host walk proving resumed action. Current path only checks lamp present → ours/hold → lamp gone. Also run existing guardian hold/claim/resume/reset unit tests and record them under docs/compat/evidence/world-capabilities/harness/ as source evidence.

5. Process backstops: nav_full should keep the 400s process bound (scenario deadline 360s); current outer deadline is runner.deadline().max(180s) → 360s only. Prefer unique per-run account minting (serial) over fixed w{rev}{i}/g{rev} names.

Minimum to re-request review: fix the harness to satisfy 1–5, refresh 03a report + support evidence, commit only harness/report/evidence, re-run focused compile/clippy/diff-check (no live launch).

comments.author: reviewer
comments.body:
Round-2 execution review of 235bbd85 (+ root frontend 6c70aed6 in same-card scope).

Verified PASS / fixed from round 1:
- Scope: commit 235bbd85 touches only world_boundary_live.rs, 03a-world-live-harness.md, support-checks.log.
- Mainland seed_at(3220,3212,0) + observed logout/relogin + require_mainland_base=true on every cell.
- nav_full sets engine_speed_ms=None and records it; outer process bound 400s.
- nav_door single-account (truncate profiles, clear companions), outside tele prep, no set_scene_settle(0), 180s outer bound, arrival predicate 2817/z>=3443.
- Unique per-run account minting.
- Guardian path: give lamp, inv+strength XP baseline, hold/interface/consume/XP/walk observations present in code.
- Guardian unit evidence: cargo test -p host --lib random::tests --no-default-features → 43 passed (includes lamp_auto_*, hold/claim/resume paths).
- Frontend 6c70aed6: panel+tui ScenarioRunner::with_world(play.world()) only (4 lines).
- Fresh checks now PASS (support-checks.log is stale on compile):
  - cargo test -p host-play --test world_boundary_live --features memory-profile --no-run
  - cargo clippy -p host-play --test world_boundary_live --features memory-profile --no-deps -- -D warnings
  - cargo fmt --check on harness alone is clean; dirty banking WIP still formats-diff host-play/src/lib.rs if fmt is run without path filter.

Blocking remaining gaps (orch-confirmed + independent check):

1. nav_door door identity is wrong vs production helper.
   world_boundary_live::door_id only matches packed closed origin (2816,3438). scenario::nearest_door_loc + test nearest_door_loc_returns_the_offset_open_leaf_not_the_packed_at document open 1531 on neighboring tile (2816,3439). Current prepare_door close uses op_loc(DOOR.0, DOOR.1, DOOR_OPEN) on packed at, and opened|=id==DOOR_OPEN never sees the shifted leaf. Resolve live door identity/action from nearby snapshot locs (radius/search like nearest_door_loc); emit before/after live tile+id.

2. guardian_lamp success under-asserts.
   PASS path is only walk_sent && tile==walk_target. saw_hold and saw_interface are printed but never required, so 03a overclaims those predicates. Require saw_hold && saw_interface (and existing consume/XP/lifted-hold/walk) before PASS.

3. Live FAIL contract missing.
   revision_boundary_live wraps run in Result and on Err does eprintln!("FAIL: ..."); process::exit(1). world_boundary_live panics → libtest failure only. Match the existing FAIL + exit 1 wrapper for the ignored live entrypoint.

4. Structured receipts are not JSON.
   Phase prints use {:?} on Option<(i32,i32,i32)> → Some((...)), invalid JSON. Use serde_json (as revision_boundary_live) for identity/baseline/door/pass receipts.

Minimum to re-request review: fix 1–4 in the harness, refresh 03a + support-checks.log (record the now-passing host-play compile/clippy), commit only harness/report/evidence, no live launch, no WIP/frontend edits.
